privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: At Meapica, the privacy of our users — especially when it comes to children's data — is our top priority.
privacy.section1Text: Meapica is the data controller for personal data collected through meapica.com.
privacy.section2Text: We collect the data necessary to create your personalized book: child's name, age, city, interests, and physical characteristics for illustration. We also collect email and shipping address to process orders.
privacy.section3Text: We use your data exclusively to: generate the personalized story, process payment and shipping, and communicate with you about your order. We never sell data to third parties.
privacy.section4Text: Processing is based on the execution of the contract (your order) and your explicit consent when creating an account.
privacy.section5Text: We use Supabase (storage), Stripe (payments), and Gelato (printing) as third-party services. Each service has its own privacy policy.
privacy.section6Text: You can exercise your rights of access, rectification, erasure, restriction, and portability by contacting us at hola@meapica.com.
privacy.section7Text: We do not collect data directly from children. The child's data is provided by the parent or legal guardian who creates the book.

terms.title: Legal Notice and Terms of Use

terms.section1Text: Meapica is a personalized children's book creation platform operated from Spain by Xavier Huix Trenco, with registered address at Carrer Aribau 140, 5º, 08036 Barcelona (Spain). Contact: hola@meapica.com.
terms.section2Text: Meapica offers the creation of personalized children's stories with unique illustrations, printed on demand.
terms.section3Text: Illustrations are created specifically for each book. The buyer receives a personal, non-commercial use license for the purchased book.

terms.section5Text: Books are printed on demand. Delivery time is 7-14 business days. As personalized products, returns are not accepted except for manufacturing defects.
terms.section6Text: Meapica does not guarantee uninterrupted service availability. Illustrations may vary and a specific result is not guaranteed.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.intro: Meapica uses strictly necessary cookies for the operation of the service.
cookies.section1Text: Cookies are small text files stored in your browser when visiting a website.
cookies.section2Text: We only use technical cookies necessary to: keep your user session active, remember the selected language, and manage the purchase process. We do not use marketing or third-party tracking cookies.
cookies.section3Text: Stripe (payment processor) may set its own cookies during the checkout process. Please refer to Stripe's cookie policy for more information.
cookies.section4Text: You can configure your browser to reject cookies, although this may affect the operation of the service.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.intro: Everything you need to know about Meapica's personalized storybooks.
faq.section1Text: You choose the adventure, customize the character with your child's name, age and features, and our technology writes a unique story with original illustrations. No other child in the world will ever have the same book.
faq.section2Text: Once the order is placed, the book is printed and shipped within 7-12 business days in Spain, and 10-15 business days in the rest of Europe. You'll receive an email with the tracking number when your package leaves the workshop.
faq.section3Text: Yes! You can choose the name, age, hair/eye/skin color, hairstyle, gender, and even add their pet, favorite food, or future dream. Everything appears in the story and illustrations.
faq.section4Text: We use FSC-certified Munken 170g paper with a soft cream tone that's easy on the eyes. The binding is thread-sewn with reinforced covers, built to withstand years of readings.
faq.section5Title: Can I request changes after purchase?
faq.section5Text: Since each book is a unique edition generated on the spot, it cannot be modified once created. That's why we show you a full preview before purchase, so you can review the story and illustrations.
faq.section6Text: The book measures 20×20 cm (8×8 inches), the ideal format for little hands. It contains 32 inner pages with 12 illustrated double-page scenes, cover, personalized dedication, and back cover.

shipping.title: Shipping & Packaging
shipping.intro: Every Meapica book is a gift. That's why the experience of receiving it at home should be as special as opening it.
shipping.section1Text: Mainland Spain: 7-12 business days. Balearic & Canary Islands: 10-15 business days. Rest of Europe: 10-15 business days. Each book is printed on demand, which is why the timeframe includes artisanal production.
shipping.section2Text: Standard shipping is included in the book price. No hidden costs or surprises in the box.
shipping.section3Text: Your book arrives protected in a recycled cardboard box, plastic-free. We use environmentally friendly materials so your gift is consistent with the values we teach our children.
shipping.section4Text: Once the book leaves the workshop, you'll receive an email with the tracking number. You can also check your order status from your user dashboard at meapica.com.
